mcq_fix.s: Which of the following is regarded as an effective reason for slow agricultural development in India?

mcq_drop.why: oddly worded ('bank-nationalisation era in the discussion on loan waivers')

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: 2011 crop holiday committee chaired by Mohan Kanda (option 4), not Jayati Ghosh
suspect key: Agri Census 2015-16 - Rajasthan has the largest operated area, so (iii) is also true

patterns: APPSC asks AP-specific institutional facts: CCRC full form/purpose, 2011 crop holiday committee chair, YSR crop insurance crop count, RWBCIS aim
APPSC G1/G2 2017 used Agri Census holding shares (small holdings ~85% of holdings, ~44% of area) and ADSI 2015 top cause (bankruptcy/indebtedness)
Other PSCs ask crop-insurance history (CCIS 1985, NAIS 1999, WBCIS first in Karnataka) and census/holding statistics
App MCQs rely heavily on study-report numbers (Guntur study, EAC-PM, 77th Round) and debate statements; trim opinion items, keep scheme/committee recall
Traps: KALIA (Odisha) vs Rythu Bandhu (Telangana) vs Annadata Sukhibhava (AP); LEC 2011 vs CCRC 2019; Radhakrishna (indebtedness) vs Swaminathan (farmers)
